name: wave
description: A recording's waveform: the memo's one fixed shape (the 14:05 phrase) at a fixed pitch, repeated along the row, aria-hidden. A wider row shows more of the phrase; the bars never widen. The duration beside it carries the information. Draws in once on arrival.

size.description: row: --tap tall, in a recording row. big: the capture screen's waveform, 96px tall and the full width (was .wave.big); the same pitch, the bars scaled to its height.

states.empty: n/a: a recording always has a drawing

a11y.role: none: aria-hidden; the duration beside it is the information

responsive.1200: the draw-in runs 520ms (legacy context .app; revision 49 keeps it under 45px a frame)

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css E5 (.wave) with its own copy of the draw keyframes.
The default size (row) is no longer written as an attribute (only big has a rule).
Slot drawing: a waveform authored in several groups (02-timeline). Pages round 3.

v4 round 10: the drawing is the wave's own: the 14:05 phrase as a tile at the 1440 pitch (bars 1.77px every 6.19px), repeated as a mask on currentColor, so it never stretches. A span, not an svg; the viewBox prop and the path and drawing slots go.
